topic: Skipping renters insurance vs carrying a policy when the upstairs unit floods (Dashiell vs Winnie)

scenes.narration: One burst pipe upstairs can wipe out everything a tenant owns. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench under a comic banner reading ONE BURST PIPE, water pouring through a ceiling behind her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dashiell and Winnie rent identical apartments below the same neighbor.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man dashiell and woman winnie in identical apartments with the same unit above them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That neighbor's water heater bursts and floods both units overnight.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a burst water heater and water flooding down into two apartments at night, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Building insurance covers the building, never a tenant's belongings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a policy page reading COVERS THE BUILDING ONLY beside soaked furniture, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Dashiell skipped renters insurance to save fifteen dollars monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man dashiell waving away an insurance flyer, a small tag reading FIFTEEN A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He loses a laptop, a mattress, and every winter coat.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man dashiell holding a soaked laptop beside a ruined mattress and coats, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Replacing everything costs him eight thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt pile totaling EIGHT THOUSAND beside empty shelves, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Winnie pays that same fifteen dollars for renters coverage.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman winnie holding a small policy card stamped RENTERS COVERAGE FIFTEEN A MONTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her policy replaces belongings and pays for a hotel stay.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman winnie checking into a hotel with a claim paper stamped LOSS OF USE COVERED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She files photos and receipts and is reimbursed in weeks.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman winnie uploading damage photos, a claim screen reading APPROVED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Fifteen dollars monthly stood between eight thousand and zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a balance scale weighing a tiny coin against a stack labeled EIGHT THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Your landlord's policy never covers your things. Get renters coverage. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a banner reading RENTERS COVERAGE PROTECTS YOUR STUFF, kids comic book illustration
